_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for core-open-loop-bias-pex on the `klt sim`
harness (issue #278). The per-experiment half of the adapter contract:
sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT from this file.
Claim: sg13g2-bandgap's bandgap_core, re-simulated against #272's trim-bearing re-extraction (255 rppd ladder units realising trim code 128 as mask metal, 533 wire resistors, 255 ground caps, 44 coupling caps -- no behavioural XXTRIM/RS<bit> cards anywhere), still produces a PTAT delta-VBE and a summed CTAT+PTAT vref across the full PVT grid with its mirror legs' geometry taken from the routed layout. First grid point is anchored on #272's own one-point probe (vref 1.052999 V, R1_eff 66123 ohm at typ/27C/3.30V): a point far from that anchor means the bench, not the extraction, is wrong. NOT a claim against any ratified spec row.
Netlist provenance: layout/bandgap_core/bandgap_core.pex.spice (#272's trim-bearing re-extraction) + design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice, transformed by sim/tools/gen_pex_netlist_body.py -- the DUT body is generated, never hand-transcribed. Bipolar devices are still schematic-sourced (klt's curated sg13g2 deck does not extract them); the rppd/rhigh resistors, MOS geometry and every wire parasitic are extracted.
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
